entries.text: MEMORANDUM OPINION AND ORDER: On July 17, 2026, the Court ordered Plaintiff Ligio Lopez, who is currently incarcerated at Mid-State Correctional Facility and proceeding here without counsel, to show cause why this case should not be transferred to the United States District Court for the Northern District of New York. See ECF No. 4. In a letter dated July 29, 2026, Lopez requested to "withdraw" his case "without prejudice" and sought a refund of his filing fees. See ECF No . 5. As stated in an endorsement dated August 18, 2026, the Court construed Lopez's letter to be a notice of voluntary dismissal pursuant to Rule 41(a)(1)(A)(i) of the Federal Rules of Civil Procedure and denied the request for a refund of the f iling fee. See ECF No. 6. Thus, the case was dismissed.Since that time, Lopez has filed several more documents, some of which appear to repeat the requests he made in the July 29, 2026 letter and some of which suggest a desire to proceed with this ca se. In either event, the July 29, 2026 dismissal "was self-executing and effective immediately"; thus, the dismissal is "not subject to vacatur." Alix v. McKinsey & Co., 470 F. Supp. 3d 310, 317 (S.D.N.Y. 2020) (cleaned up) (citin g cases). Accordingly, any requests Lopez makes in those submissions are denied. That said, dismissal of this case was "without prejudice," so Lopez is free to file a new lawsuit.
